name: featured-icon
title: Featured Icon
description: Static featured icon shell with chrome variants, semantic colors, sizes, shape, and a plain glyph mode.

api.description: Static featured icon shell for empty states, feature rows, and status marks. Pass any icon as children. Variants supply chrome recipes; override background, border, icon color, icon size, radius, and elevation shadow when you need a custom look.

props.name: variant
props.description: Chrome treatment. soft is a tinted fill. halo stacks a solid disc on a wash. filled is a solid plate. outline draws concentric rings in a fixed box. surface and plate are bordered elevated shells. plain is a bare sized glyph with no plate; it inherits the surrounding text color.

props.name: size
props.description: Outer footprint from 12px (2xs) to 62px (3xl). Also sets the default glyph size for that step. Plain uses the glyph size as the host size.

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic accent recipe for fill, rings, and glyph when background, borderColor, and iconColor are omitted. brand follows primary so it stays visible in light and dark themes. Ignored for plain, which inherits the surrounding text color unless iconColor is set.

props.name: shape
props.description: Container geometry. Omit to use the variant default: circle for soft, halo, and outline; square for filled, surface, and plate. Ignored for plain.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius override. When omitted, circle uses full and square uses the size step. Ignored for plain.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Elevation shadow for filled, surface, and plate. Set false to keep the border without the drop shadow.

props.name: background
props.description: Container fill as a CSS color. Overrides the variant background recipe.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border and ring stroke as a CSS color. Overrides the variant border recipe.

props.name: iconColor
props.description: Glyph color as a CSS color. Overrides the variant icon recipe. On plain, use this only when you need a color different from the surrounding text.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Glyph size step, independent of the container size. Same scale as size. For example size md with iconSize xl keeps a 32px shell and draws a 24px glyph. On plain, this also sets the host footprint.

props.name: glyphShadow
props.description: Plain only. When true, apply the glyph drop shadow for busy surfaces. Set false to turn the shadow off.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon content, usually an SVG. Sized by the component via the glyph slot.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the host.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-bg
props.description: Resolved container fill. Set by variant or the background prop.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-border
props.description: Resolved border and ring stroke. Set by variant or the borderColor prop.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-icon
props.description: Resolved glyph color. Set by variant or the iconColor prop.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-elevation
props.description: Drop shadow for elevated variants. none when shadow is false.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-brand-solid
props.description: Brand solid disc for halo. Stays dark under a light glyph in both themes.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-brand-on-solid
props.description: Light glyph on the brand solid disc. Stays light in both themes.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-size-2xs
props.description: 2xs container size (12px).

props.name: --df-featured-icon-size-md
props.description: md container size (32px).

props.name: --df-featured-icon-size-3xl
props.description: 3xl container size (62px).

props.name: --df-featured-icon-glyph-md
props.description: md glyph size (16px).

props.name: --df-featured-icon-radius-md
props.description: Square corner radius at md when radius is omitted.

props.name: --df-featured-icon-plain-glyph-filter
props.description: Drop shadow for plain glyphs on busy surfaces.
